messages:
elaine_marketing: Quick alert  noticed ~14 inbound webinar leads landed in HubSpot but never got an owner. HS property `enrichment_status` says `pending_api`. Reps reported no pings.
noah_revops: thanks Elaine. which intake path? webinar webhook? region?
elaine_marketing: APAC webinar funnel. source=webinar, campaign=redwood-q2-demo.
ravi_eng: looked at logs: enrichment service returned intermittent 429s for a 7-minute window. Our intake lambda currently treats `pending_api` as blocking for round-robin. leads sat in the queue.
tori_sdr: missed those. a couple were hot. we need a quick fallback so reps get notified.
noah_revops: short-term: set a timeout that converts blocking states to advisory after X secs and assign to `sdr_notify_pool`. What X?
tori_sdr: 8s feels ok. shorter could assign too many low-signal leads.
ravi_eng: agree on 8s. I'll ship a tiny change to canary to make `pending_api` advisory after 8s and emit an analytics event. snippet below.
```
// intake handler
if (lead.enrichment_status === 'pending_api') {
  if (now - lead.enrichment_started > 8000) {
    assignOwner('sdr_notify_pool', lead, 'timeout_fallback')
  } else {
    enqueueForEnrichment(lead)
  }
}
```
leadflow_bot: Deploy started: intake-lambda v1.9.3-canary -> 3 nodes. CI green.
ravi_eng: canary ran; test payloads show fallback at ~8s for 9/10 tests. will add `assignment_reason=timeout_fallback` and `hs_auto_assigned=true` property in HS so ops can filter.
noah_revops: please also record `fallback_timeout_reason=api_429` tag on analytics so we can cohort. add alert: fallback_rate > 4% in 1h -> page revops.
elaine_marketing: I'll add a note to the HS workflow and put a temporary banner in the webinar campaign doc so SDRs know auto-assigned leads may have incomplete enrichment.
tori_sdr: what about duplicate notifications when enrichment finishes and owner changes?
ravi_eng: we will not reassign unless a lead meets explicit reassignment rules. we will update owner only if enrichment yields `high_priority=true` and a special flag `allow_reassign_on_score=true`. otherwise update properties only.
noah_revops: plan: 1) prod rollout after 10m (ravi) 2) analytics event + dashboard (noah) 3) HS workflow note + `hs_auto_assigned` (elaine) 4) 48h conversion cohort and retro (all).
leadflow_bot: Canary complete; metrics stable.
ravi_eng: rolling to prod in waves. monitoring fallback_rate and conversion delta.
leadflow_bot: Prod rollout done: intake-lambda v1.9.3 -> 100% intake. current fallback_rate=2.1% (last 30m).
tori_sdr: monitoring Slack. will flag any rep complaints.
noah_revops: created dashboard and a scheduled query to run cohort daily. retro invite set for 11am PT tomorrow to finalize `enrichment_status` semantics.
elaine_marketing: added HS workflow comment and a small playbook for SDRs: treat `hs_auto_assigned=true` as tentative; quick 1-min touch, then wait for enrichment if no clear intent. posted in #sales-ops.
leadflow_bot: Alert cleared. Thread archived after 72h with no SLA regressions.
